2.293.8
Style.BorderStyle
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Style.BorderStyle element specifies the style of a border. This element is optional and is of type
BorderStyle.
Following is the parent element of the Style.BorderStyle element.
Parent elements
Style
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Style.BorderStyle element.
 <xsd:element name="BorderStyle" type="BorderColorStyleWidthType" minOccurs="0" />
